name: Scorching Ash Form
levelText: alchemist 4, arcanist 4, investigator 4, redmantisassassin 4, sorcerer 4, wizard 4 (ifrit)
componentsText: S, M (a bit of gauze and a handful of ashes)
description: This spell functions like gaseous form, except the target becomes a visible swirl of hot ash and smoke instead of harmless translucent gas. The target gains the fire subtype. Any creature that begins its turn sharing a space with the target takes 2d6 points of fire damage and must make a Fortitude save (DC 15, + 1 per previous check) or suffer the effects of smoke inhalation.
